description: Our recommendations service answers slowly since this morning and some requests fail. There were no deploys today.

findings.title: Incident Management at Spotify | Spotify Engineering
findings.summary: Lack of exponential backoff in a microservice caused a cascading failure, leading to notable service degradation.

findings.title: Postmortem — why Allegro went down | blog.allegro.tech
findings.summary: E-commerce site went down after a sudden traffic spike caused by a marketing campaign. The outage was caused by a configuration error in cluster resource management which prevented more service instances from starting even though hardware resources were available.

hypotheses.cause: Possible cascading failure between services, if retries have no exponential backoff.
hypotheses.matches: Slow and failing requests between services.
hypotheses.differs: No clear trigger and no error messages in the description.

gaps: There are no error messages or logs from the service.
We do not know which other services it calls.
